items.title: PayRewards: Pay business bills by credit card, earn transferable points (Atmos Rewards coming soon!)
items.why: Bill pay with transferable points is a low-cost entry for business card rewards; evaluate PayRewards terms and Atmos transfer partnership.
items.summary_ai: PayRewards lets users pay business bills by card and earn transferable points, with Atmos Rewards support coming soon.
items.take: Bill pay with transferable points is a low-cost entry for business card rewards; evaluate PayRewards terms and Atmos transfer partnership.
